shares_target.name: shares_target
shares_target.value:
case "shares"."kind" when 'album' then "shares"."album_id" is not null and "shares"."playlist_id" is null and "shares"."recording_id" is null
    when 'playlist' then "shares"."playlist_id" is not null and "shares"."album_id" is null and "shares"."recording_id" is null
    when 'track' then "shares"."recording_id" is not null and "shares"."playlist_id" is null
    else false end
